about: Hand-made map from NIH RePORTER core project numbers (NIGMS T32, Medical Scientist Training Program) to RMH Med Schools slugs. Read by scripts/medschools/build-mdphd-data.ts to write data/medschools/mstp-t32.json. Every core project in the RePORTER input must appear here, either under grants (an active MD-PhD or DO-PhD MSTP, matched to one school) or under excluded (with the reason). A grant whose school is not certain is never mapped: it goes under excluded as unmatched. Checked by hand on 2026-11-24.

T32GM152319.why: Case Western Reserve University's MSTP. The Cleveland Clinic Lerner College of Medicine is not mapped: the grant names Case Western only.

T32GM154667.why: The title names the Michigan State University College of Osteopathic Medicine MSTP (a DO-PhD program), so it is the DO school, not the MD college.
